title: Delta 56302 Adjustable Shower Slide Bar / Grab Bar, Chrome

comparisons.notes: Same Delta model 56302, chrome 24 in. adjustable slide/grab bar

writeup: Delta's 56302 is a 24-inch adjustable slide bar that doubles as a 1.25-inch grab bar, in chrome, with a 60 to 82 inch stretchable metal hose included (hand shower sold separately). Woot has it for $60.99 while Home Depot lists the same model at $180.54.
amazon_match_notes: Amazon listing shows Delta model 56302, chrome, UPC 034449668965
